title: V03 IGNORANCE-ORTHOGONAL TRIO
pre_registration:

[1] FALSIFIERS: R = -ln A / E[D] (A = P(N=0); kernel-free per L07 46/46);
    U = std(D)/E[D] (radius-free; kernel-TAGGED per N04);
    B: slack = E[D^2] E[v^4] / (3 E[Dv^2]^2) >= 1 (density-free, J05/J06 exact).
[2] GRID: CORE 36 cells: (central|volume) x q{0,3,10} x tau0{0.5,1,2} x
